India's E-Rail Network Expansion Faces Delays and Funding Issues

The Indian government has announced plans to expand its electronic rail network, but delays and funding issues have hindered progress. The project aims to modernize India's rail infrastructure, reducing congestion and increasing efficiency. However, critics argue that the government's lack of transparency and inadequate planning have led to these setbacks. On the other hand, supporters claim that the expansion will create jobs and stimulate economic growth. The delays and funding issues raise concerns about the project's feasibility and impact on the country's transportation sector.
